title: Connect the Web Terminal to a wallet
description: Web Terminal block: start a fresh slot browser (MetaMask extension or injected strict wallet) with the reserved fixture account and open the market's order page. With connect=true (default) connect through the header and, in extension mode, approve the connection in MetaMask; proves one account-permission request and zero signatures. With connect=false it stops at the loaded order page (for surfaces that need no wallet). Selects the account through the fixture; does not trade.

launch.intent: Start the slot browser with a fresh profile and the reserved fixture account in the requested wallet

open_window.intent: Start counting what the app asks the main wallet from this point

open_market.intent: Open the reserved market's order page on the slot dev server

choose_connect.intent: Connect the wallet only when the caller needs a connected session

page_ready.intent: Confirm the order page rendered its order form for a visitor with no wallet connected

capture_page.label: session-order-page
capture_page.intent: Keep a picture of the order page before any wallet connects

connect_visible.intent: Confirm the trader sees the Connect wallet button

connect.intent: Ask to connect a wallet as the trader

approve_connect.intent: Let MetaMask connect the reserved account to the Web Terminal

connected.intent: Confirm the header now shows the connected account

capture_connected.label: session-connected
capture_connected.intent: Keep a picture of the connected order page

session_signatures.intent: Prove connecting asked for one account permission and no signature

signer.description: extension: the real MetaMask extension confirms every wallet request (acceptance mode). injected: the strict test wallet signs in the harness (fast mode).

account.description: Wallet fixture account reserved for this slot (dev1 on mmt-1, Trading on mmt-2).

market.description: Testnet market reserved for this run.

connect.description: true: connect the wallet through the header. false: stop at the loaded order page with no wallet connected.
